entry.title: Sockeye Maintenance October 20, 2026 09:00 - 18:00 PT
entry.content:
THIS IS A SCHEDULED EVENT Oct 20, 09:00 - 18:00 PDT

Oct 8, 12:18 PDT
Scheduled - UBC ARC Sockeye will be unavailable on Tuesday, October 20 from 09:00 until 18:00 PT for scheduled maintenance.

User Impact:

1. During this time, you will be unable to log in or transfer data to/from Sockeye, OnDemand, and Chinook.

2. All jobs will be queued. The scheduler will not start any job if its requested walltime overlaps with the
maintenance window, even if resources are available. Only jobs expected to finish before downtime
begins will be scheduled, if resources allow.

3. In rare cases, running jobs may need to be resubmitted. Please checkpoint or complete your jobs before
the maintenance window to avoid lost progress, and check your job queue afterward.

entry.title: BC Time Zone Change Planning
entry.content:
Oct 9, 14:14 PDT
Investigating - British Columbia has adopted permanent year-round daylight saving time (Pacific Time), with the change scheduled to take effect on November 1. We recognize that some community members may have questions about the impact on calendars, devices, and scheduled meetings.

UBC IT is actively working with Microsoft and Apple to coordinate the required time zone updates for computers, mobile devices, and calendaring services. We anticipate updates from our vendors will begin rolling out next week.

UBC IT plans to provide detailed guidance by October 16 outlining what to expect and any actions that may be required.
Thank you for your patience as we work to ensure a smooth transition.

entry.title: EASD Planned Maintenance for Minor EASD RDS Upgrade on October 6th, 2026 17:00 - 20:00 PT
entry.content:
Oct 6, 20:00 PDT
Completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

Oct 6, 17:00 PDT
In progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

Sep 29, 14:51 PDT
Scheduled - Multiple enterprise services will undergo maintenance on October 6th, 2026, from 17:00 - 20:00 PT.

Maintenance will be performed after hours to minimize potential impacts.

Release Notes

The following maintenance activities will be completed:

Upgrade EASD AWS Aurora PostgreSQL Database iecrds-prd-11 from v15.17 to v15.18
Apply AWS OS patches
Release Impact

No downtime is expected under normal circumstances.

In the event of an unforeseen issue:

Impacted Services

EASD RDS may experience an interruption of up to 5 minutes during the upgrade. The read-only instance will remain available, so the impact should be limited to applications or integrations connecting to the read-write instance.
DAF data is expected to remain online throughout the maintenance window.
Mule APIs, including services available through api.ubc.ca, may experience intermittent outages if they connect to the read-write instance or if their connection strings have not been updated to use the standby configuration.
Scheduled Rundeck jobs may be delayed during the maintenance window and will be re-run after the outage, where applicable.
All services are expected to recover automatically after the maintenance is completed.
